content: {"praised":["Director Franco Zeffirelli delivers a masterful adaptation.","Ennio Morricone's music enhances emotional depth.","Sets and costumes are beautifully crafted.","Film holds audience's attention throughout.","Story faithfully conveys Jane Eyre's themes."],"criticized":["Lacks passion between Jane and Rochester.","Dialogue delivered without emotion.","Missing key scenes, reducing understanding.","Acting considered poor and unconvincing.","Sets inferior to earlier BBC version."]}
